title: Enter check-in kiosk
description: Open Kiosk and choose Check-in for front-desk attendance.

steps.title: Kiosk button
steps.body: Kiosk mode is for the front desk / floor. Admins can enter Check-in; organizers use Browse.

steps.title: Choose Check-in
steps.body: Select Check-in. Members then check in with PIN; payment gates may appear when required.

steps.title: Check-in kiosk UI
steps.body: Toolbar shows attendance count and Present filter. Each row has Check-in / Check-out. Use Restore privileges to exit.
